job_title: Entry Level Software Programmer / Developer (.NET, C#)
job_description:
Rowe Price, we identify and actively invest in opportunities to help people thrive in an evolving world. As a premier global asset management organization with more than 85 years of experience, we provide investment solutions and a broad range of equity, fixed income, and multi-asset capabilities to individuals, advisors, institutions, and retirement plan sponsors. We take an active, independent approach to investing, offering our dynamic perspective and meaningful partnership so our clients can feel more confident.

With a career at the firm, you can expect opportunities to create real impact at work and in your community. Rowe Price’s Workflow Solutions team builds and operates enterprise workflow applications that automate critical business processes across the organization. We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer with strong experience delivering AWS-based applications and APIs, who can design reliable integrations and contribute to scalable workflow solutions.

Appian is the primary workflow platform used by the team.

Prior

Appian experience is beneficial but not required—experience delivering workflow or platform-based solutions, along with a demonstrated ability and willingness to learn new technologies, is essential. Success in this position requires effective communication skills, sound engineering judgment, and a passion for delivering high-quality, production-ready systems. What You’ll Do Design, build, and support enterprise workflow applications using the Appian platform.

Design and implement scalable integrations between Appian and AWS-based applications using REST APIs, events, and secure service-to-service communication patterns. Collaborate with backend, cloud, and platform engineering teams to align integration standards, security models, and operational standards. Conduct design and code reviews, providing constructive feedback that improves quality and consistency.

Evaluate tradeoffs between short-term delivery and long-term maintainability. Support production issue troubleshooting, incident resolution, and root-cause analysis for enterprise workflow applications and integrations. Maintain the performance, reliability, and overall health of the Appian platform in partnership with Appian support, ensuring stable, well-performing workflows across the enterprise.

Bachelor’s degree or the equivalent combination of education and relevant experience AND 5+ years of progressive software development experience building enterprise applications and integrations. Strong experience designing, developing, deploying, and supporting backend systems using Java or equivalent programming languages such as Python. Hands-on experience with AWS cloud services including S3, SQS, Lambda, EC2, ECS/Fargate, CloudWatch, IAM, and related services.

Strong experience building and supporting integrations with AWS-hosted applications using REST APIs and event-driven patterns.

Experience working in regulated or highly controlled environments, including financial services, compliance, or risk management domains. Applicants for employment in the US must have work authorization that does not now or in the future require sponsorship of a visa for employment authorization in the United States (e.g., H1-B visa, F-1 visa (OPT), TN visa or any other non-immigrant work status) WHAT TO EXPECT AFTER APPLYING 1. If you are eligible, you will be asked to record video responses to introductory questions with our vendor partner, HireVue.

Work Flexibility

This role is eligible for hybrid work, with up to three days per week from home.
